title: Canonical NESC environment services
scope: Unify geodesy, gravity, atmosphere, wind, and output conventions
deliverables: versioned environment collection and output adapter
exit_criteria: Same environment services support atmospheric and orbital cases without model-specific forks

title: Orbital spheroid, cylinder, and ISS

exit_criteria: Orbital cases pass defined ensemble tolerances

title: Full F-16 NESC scenario family

title: Rocket independent trajectory qualification
scope: Compare the existing rocket package against complete participating-simulation histories

title: Generate reduced-order families

deliverables: tiered model families sharing provenance and acceptance vectors

title: DAVE-ML collection round trip

deliverables: txcollection schema, exporter, and CI round-trip suite
